title: Jerry Skill Canonical Source Schema
description: Validates .jerry.skill.yaml canonical source files for Jerry Framework skills. Contains Jerry extension fields ONLY (governance metadata). Anthropic official fields live in SKILL.md frontmatter validated by anthropic-skill-frontmatter-v1.schema.json. Pattern follows agent-canonical-v1.schema.json.
$comment: SYNC NOTE: The skill_name $def is duplicated in anthropic-skill-frontmatter-v1.schema.json. Changes to the name pattern, maxLength, or reserved-word exclusions MUST be applied to BOTH schemas in the same commit.

skill_name.description: Kebab-case skill name matching parent directory. Max 64 characters.

name.description: Kebab-case skill name. Must match parent directory name.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it. Max 1024 chars. No XML. Mirrors anthropic-skill-frontmatter-v1.schema.json constraint.

activation-keywords.description: Trigger phrases for skill routing. Used by mandatory-skill-usage.md trigger map for proactive skill invocation (H-22).

agents.description: Agent names available in this skill. Used for agent discovery and routing.

context_injection.description: Dynamic context injection configuration. Defines files and rules to inject into skill context at load time.

template_variables.description: Template variables available in context files.

always_load.description: Files always loaded when skill activates.

conditional_load.description: Files loaded conditionally based on rules.

license.description: Open source license identifier (e.g., MIT, Apache-2.0).

metadata.description: Custom key-value pairs (author, mcp-server, category, tags).
